items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Jack Carey, myself, George Foster, Little Chinese, George Boyd.

ctx.x: That's right, he's on the record with you I think. Yeah, yeah.

I believe. Well who was with Jack Carey in there? Jack Carey, myself, George Foster, Little Chinese, George Boyd. Well I'll tell you about that now. They had a boy, I don't know if he's Kent the Old Man Robichaux or not, but we used to call him Robichaux and he claimed he's a relation to Old Man Robichaux, he played violin at the Larry Theater. He's real light with nice hair. Well he played clarinet with us at the Moes. Played what?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was this Foster fellow? What Foster? >> [INTERVIEWEE] I mean George Foster. No, Andrew Foster you just said.

ctx.x: Who was this Foster fellow? What Foster?
I mean George Foster. No, Andrew Foster you just said.
Oh he was the guy who used to take bands out.
